rows.message: Let's battle!
rows.reply: Ha! Finally someone with guts. My Rattata hasn't lost all week, and I don't plan on starting now.

rows.message: I challenge you. Right here, right now.
rows.reply: Another one? Word gets around fast. Fine, but don't cry when my Rattata wipes the floor with you.

rows.message: Bet you can't beat my team. Fight me.
rows.reply: You're late to the party, kid. Two others already lined up for a beating today. Get in line or get lost.

rows.message: On se fait un combat ?
rows.reply: Ha, another challenger? Fine — my Rattata's been hungry all day. You'd better not be all talk like the last three.

rows.message: Want to trade? My Pidgey for your Rattata.
rows.reply: My Rattata? You're joking, right? That little guy's the only reason anyone on Route 2 knows my name. Beat me in a battle first, then maybe we talk trades.

rows.message: Let's swap monsters, I'll give you my best one.
rows.reply: Ha! Everyone wants my Rattata today. What's your "best one," then? Don't waste my time with a Caterpie.

rows.message: Bye, I have to go.
rows.reply: Yeah, run along. Everyone on Route 2's got somewhere better to be than talking to me.

rows.message: Get lost, I'm busy.
rows.reply: Busy doing what, staring at the grass? Route 2's got one trainer worth battling and you're looking at him.

rows.message: Nice weather today, isn't it?
rows.reply: Nice weather, huh? You come all the way out to Route 2 to talk about clouds, or do you actually want something?

rows.message: What's your favorite monster?
rows.reply: Depends who's asking. You got a trade in mind, or just collecting answers for a quiz?

rows.message: I don't want to battle, I'm just looking around.
rows.reply: Looking around, huh? Everyone on Route 2 wants something. What's your angle?

rows.message: How long have you been standing here?
rows.reply: Long enough to see you eyeing my Rattata. You want a trade, or just wasting my time?

rows.message: I'll take that sword. Here's the gold.
rows.reply: Gold first, then hands off. I haven't weighed your coin yet, and that blade's worth more than most folks' whole cart.

rows.message: Sell me a blade, please, I can pay now.
rows.reply: You can pay now, can you? Fine, but I'm in the middle of something. Wait your turn and don't rush me.

rows.message: Hurry up, old woman, I don't have all day!
rows.reply: Old woman, is it? Then you can wait even longer. The forge doesn't hurry for rude little pups.

rows.message: Your blades are junk and so are you.
rows.reply: Junk, is it? Then you won't mind walking out of my shop with nothing. I've got three paying customers ahead of you anyway.

rows.message: Thanks, goodbye!
rows.reply: Off with you, then. Door's behind you.

rows.message: What are you working on today?
rows.reply: A dented helm, if you must know. Three customers waiting and none of them talk this much.

rows.message: Is it hard, being a smith?
rows.reply: Hard? It's hot, loud, and people like you ask me questions while I'm working. What do you want?

rows.message: I'm just looking, thanks.
rows.reply: Looking costs nothing. Touching costs fingers. Keep your hands where I can see them.

rows.message: Let's battle!
rows.reply: Finally, someone with guts. My Pidgeotto's been itching for a real fight all morning.

rows.message: I challenge you. Right here, right now.
rows.reply: About time somebody with guts showed up. My monsters have been bored all morning. You're on!

rows.message: Bet you can't beat my team. Fight me.
rows.reply: Bet? You just handed me a free win. My Pidgeotto's been waiting all morning for someone this cocky.

rows.message: On se fait un combat ?
rows.reply: A battle? Let's see if you can keep up with me.

rows.message: Want to trade? My Pidgey for your Rattata.
rows.reply: A Pidgey, huh? My Rattata's got more fight in one whisker than your bird's got in both wings. Still... I'll hear you out. What else you got to sweeten the deal?

rows.message: Let's swap monsters, I'll give you my best one.
rows.reply: Best one, huh? Everyone says that. Show me what it is first, then we'll talk.

rows.message: Bye, I have to go.
rows.reply: Yeah, run along. Everyone on Route 2 talks big until it's time to actually battle.

rows.message: Get lost, I'm busy.
rows.reply: Busy losing to somebody else, huh? Route 2's right here when you grow a spine.

rows.message: Nice weather today, isn't it?
rows.reply: Yeah, sun's out, tall grass is buzzing. If you're here to chat about clouds, I'm busy — unless you brought something worth battling.

rows.message: What's your favorite monster?
rows.reply: Depends who's asking. You look like the type who'd trade me a Magikarp and call it a favor.

rows.message: I don't want to battle, I'm just looking around.
How long have you been standing here?

rows.reply: Hm.

rows.message: Sell me a blade, please, I can pay now.
rows.reply: Hm.

rows.reply: Hm.

rows.message: Your blades are junk and so are you.
rows.reply: Hm.

rows.message: Thanks, goodbye!
rows.reply: Hm.

rows.message: What are you working on today?
rows.reply: Hm.

rows.message: Is it hard, being a smith?
rows.reply: Hm.

rows.message: I'm just looking, thanks.
rows.reply: Hm.
